Bar.time: ISO-8601 timestamp, timezone-aware UTC, represents the bar's CLOSE time
Bar.constraint: low <= open <= high AND low <= close <= high

input.tick_size: float, e.g. 0.01 for BTCUSD/ETHUSD VT Markets CFD

Decision.status: one of: NO_TRIGGER | TRIGGER_LONG | TRIGGER_SHORT | INSUFFICIENT_WARMUP | TRIGGER_DEFERRED_WEEKEND
Decision.bar_time: ISO-8601 timestamp of the evaluated bar

TickResolution.outcome: one of: EXPIRED_UNFILLED | TP1_HIT | STOP_HIT | UNRESOLVED_AT_HORIZON
